newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE - INDEX UP 5.49 PCT TO NEW RECORD.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE - INDEX UP 5.49 PCT TO NEW RECORD.

text.p: * Preliminary closing data show bourse turnover at 91.4
million kroons compared to 95 million kroons.
* Index gains 5.49 percent to set new record at 383.49.
* Hoiupank most active, turns over 25.2 million
kroons to gain 5.9 kroons to 230 kroons, setting a new high.
* Hansapank gains 19.2 kroons to close at new
record high of 221.00 kroons, turns over 23.8 million kroons.
traded to gain five kroons to 240 kroons.
